mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance organs to the body was most worthwhile: the final picture showed how the signals help keep the eyes on a fixed point and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor types felt mostly like an assembly step; it showed where they sit but added less than the individual sensor explanations.

surprise.text: I hadn't understood how the weighted sensors could respond to straight-line movement. The starting-forward picture showed the layer shifting and bending hairs.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although joining the sensors and then adding the response routes was fairly predictable, and the later choices were the only offered combinations.

continue.text: Yes. The sensor pictures and final eye movement made the connection between the inner ear and balance interesting, so I'd be curious to see another body system explained that way.
